points.description: States that the region of rejection is a range/set of values (of the test statistic, i.e. the critical region) .
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says 'an area' or 'values' without linking to the test statistic/range.

points.description: States that these values lead to rejection of the null hypothesis (H0).
points.partial_credit: Half if says 'rejection' or 'reject' without naming the null hypothesis.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying the region is the range of values (of the test statistic) that cause the null hypothesis to be rejected, in any wording; 'critical region' is an acceptable synonym. Give 1 mark if only one part is clear or the idea is vague, e.g. 'values where we reject' with no mention of the null hypothesis. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers, such as saying it leads to accepting the null hypothesis.
